newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Electron unit buys software line.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Electron unit buys software line.

text.p: Thermo Information Solutions Inc, a unit of Thermo Electron Corp's Coleman Research Corp subsidiary, said Monday it acquired the operating assets and software product line of Green Pasture Software Inc.

The acquisition was made for about $3.5 million in cash, plus possible payments based on the future revenues and profitability of the business, according to a news release issued by the company. Green Pasture is an Oregon-based, privately held independent software vendor for the engineering document management market.
